nonNegotiables: The work must show the actual AI Studio OS process rather than generic AI-dashboard theater.
Iteration approval and production readiness remain separate.
Measured browser evidence, accessibility, performance and reduced-motion behavior remain visible.

creativeThesis.statement: A creative production floor where evidence, critique and craft turn ambiguous briefs into accountable work.

creativeWorlds.composition: Large live preview as stage, evidence rails as visible fly system.
creativeWorlds.narrative: The user watches raw creative work earn release in public.
creativeWorlds.spatialBehavior: Deep editorial workspace with inspection layers sliding in from the sides.
creativeWorlds.typography: Editorial display contrast paired with precise production labels.
creativeWorlds.imageLanguage: Browser captures and generated artifacts as the primary visual material.
creativeWorlds.motion: Stage-light reveals and deliberate evidence ticks.
creativeWorlds.interaction: Clicking evidence changes the visible artifact state.

creativeWorlds.composition: Dense maker console with one commanding artifact canvas and quiet tool rails.
creativeWorlds.narrative: A digital studio table where disciplines assemble around the current work.
creativeWorlds.spatialBehavior: Flat, high-density panels with no decorative depth.
creativeWorlds.typography: Grotesk utility grid with restrained serif moments for creative decisions.
creativeWorlds.imageLanguage: Work-in-progress assets, typography specimens and motion strips.
creativeWorlds.motion: Subtle object persistence and measured state transitions.
creativeWorlds.interaction: Keyboard-first queue navigation with explicit approval boundaries.

creativeWorlds.composition: Timeline-first experience where each artifact carries provenance and critique.
creativeWorlds.narrative: The site behaves like a memory system that remembers why work changed.
creativeWorlds.spatialBehavior: Horizontal archive flow that compresses into vertical evidence stacks on mobile.
creativeWorlds.imageLanguage: Version diffs, browser frames and before/after comparisons.
creativeWorlds.motion: Temporal scrubbing, version overlays and gentle continuity cues.
creativeWorlds.interaction: Users compare versions and expose the reason behind each change.

motionInteractionThesis.statement: Motion makes evidence feel earned: state changes are deliberate, quiet and tied to visible production progress.
signatureBehaviors: Evidence rails tick forward only after measured browser data arrives.
The live preview remains spatially persistent while critique and patch queues move around it.
Approval motion is restrained and never visually overrides blocked release states.
motionInteractionThesis.reducedMotionPlan: Replace continuous movement with static state changes, visible labels and preserved hierarchy.

findings.message: Hero has a distinct governing idea; verify the next section does not collapse into repetitive cards.
Paper/noise texture could be reduced if it competes with evidence legibility.

rubric.rationale: One governing idea connects process, interface and evidence.
Live preview and evidence rail create productive asymmetry.
Primary artifact, release state and patch queue have clear order.
Display and utility roles are intentionally separated.
Browser captures and production artifacts are treated as real visual material.
Motion follows evidence arrival and approval boundaries.
Interaction reinforces production state rather than generic decoration.
Mobile preserves evidence hierarchy instead of merely shrinking desktop.
No decorative 3D or visual effects without a production-state role.
The visual system is anchored in earned release, not generic AI SaaS.
Evidence theater creates a memorable model for creative production.
Polish loops show bounded refinement against rendered critique.
